name: Master of Death

abilities.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if ~ is in your graveyard, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand.

notes: 'You may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand' is one may over both halves: paying 1 life is written as losing 1 life (no AbilityCost is available inside an effect list), and the two are inseparable, so the payment can never happen without the return.

issues: At the beginning of your upkeep, IF THIS CARD IS IN YOUR GRAVEYARD, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand. — expected The ability functions from the graveyard and triggers at each of your upkeeps while the card is there. — scripted Shape is right (upkeep trigger + intervening self-in-graveyard), but queueTriggers only scans triggerPerms(s) = allPermanents(s) plus family TRIGGER_SOURCES (game.ts:2245-2257), and the only registered source is planeswalker emblems — graveyards are never scanned, so this ability can never fire. Sandbox records ability index 1 reached:false; the blind scenario confirms (stayed in graveyard, life 20 not 19, hand 0 not 1). — CR 603.6d, 113.6

you may PAY 1 LIFE — expected paying life is a cost payment, not a life-loss event — scripted {op:'lose-life', amount:1} inside a may — it will set off 'whenever you lose life' watchers and interact with loss-modifying effects that a payment would not, and it cannot fail the way an unpayable cost does. — CR 118.8, 119.3
When this creature enters, surveil 2. — expected surveil 2 — scripted {op:'surveil', amount:2} — correct. — CR 701.42
